破解 PoW：暴力连接后破解 SHA256 哈希验证，通过暴力遍历 4 位字符组合，找到符合哈希条件的前缀，完成验证。构造问题与交互：每轮发送 17 个问题（8 个基础查询如 “S0 == 1”+9 个校验查询），收集含 2 个错误的回答，转为 1/0 序列。解码真实秘密：遍历 256 种 8 位秘密组合，计算各组合对应的 17 位码字，找到与回答序列汉明距离最小的组合，即为真实秘密。完成多轮挑战：每轮提交解码结果，共进行 25 轮。全部正确后获取 flag

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-"""The_Interrogation_Room solver — 稳定交互版（精简命名版）"""importsys, socket, re, time, hashlib, random, selectfromitertoolsimportproduct
# 基本配置IP ="39.106.45.153"PORT =24586MAX_ROUND =25
# PoW字符集CHAR_SET ="abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"# ---------------- 基础IO操作 ----------------defread_line(sock, timeout=None): iftimeout: ready, _, _ = select.select([sock], [], [], timeout) ifnotready: return"" data =b"" whileTrue: char = sock.recv(1) ifnotchar: break data += char ifchar ==b"n": break returndata.decode(errors="ignore").rstrip("rn")ifdataelse""defsend_line(sock, content): sock.sendall((content +"n").encode())defprint_log(msg): print(msg, flush=True)defread_until_hit(sock, keywords, idle_time=1.5, print_msg=True): sock.setblocking(0) buf, last_recv =b"", time.monotonic() whileTrue: ready, _, _ = select.select([sock], [], [],0.1) ifready: chunk = sock.recv(4096) ifnotchunk: break buf += chunk whileb"n"inbuf: line, buf = buf.split(b"n",1) line = line.decode(errors="ignore").rstrip("rn") ifprint_msg: print_log(line) ifany(keyinlineforkeyinkeywords): sock.setblocking(1) returnline last_recv = time.monotonic() eliftime.monotonic() - last_recv > idle_time: break sock.setblocking(1) return""# ---------------- 解PoW ----------------defcrack_pow(line, report_step=200000): match= re.search(r"sha256(XXXX+([A-Za-z0-9]+))s*==s*([0-9a-f]{64})", line) ifnotmatch: raiseValueError("没找到PoW相关内容") suffix, target_hash =match.group(1),match.group(2) total =len(CHAR_SET) **4 tried, start_time =0, time.monotonic() # 遍历所有4位组合 fora, b, c, dinproduct(CHAR_SET, repeat=4): xxxx = a + b + c + d current_hash = hashlib.sha256((xxxx + suffix).encode()).hexdigest() tried +=1 ifcurrent_hash == target_hash: print_log(f"[PoW] 解出来了: XXXX={xxxx}(耗时{time.monotonic() - start_time:.2f}s)") returnxxxx # 定期输出进度 iftried % report_step ==0: cost_time = time.monotonic() - start_time speed = tried /max(cost_time,1e-9) print_log(f"[PoW] 已试={tried:,}速度={speed /1e5:.2f}e5次/秒") raiseRuntimeError("PoW没解出来")
# ---------------- 生成编码相关 ----------------defcalc_hamming(a, b): returnsum(x ^ yforx, yinzip(a, b))
# 生成合格的校验矩阵Pdefmake_good_P(): rnd = random.Random() whileTrue: # 生成9行8列的01矩阵 P = [[rnd.randint(0,1)for_inrange(8)]for_inrange(9)] # 排除全0行 ifany(sum(row) ==0forrowinP): continue # 计算所有码字的最小汉明距离 code_words = [] fors_intinrange(256): s = [(s_int >> i) &1foriinrange(8)] p = [sum(P[r][i] * s[i]foriinrange(8)) &1forrinrange(9)] code_words.append(s + p) min_dist =9 foriinrange(256): forjinrange(i +1,256): dist = calc_hamming(code_words[i], code_words[j]) ifdist < min_dist: min_dist = dist ifmin_dist <5: break ifmin_dist <5: break ifmin_dist >=5: print_log(f"[CODE] 生成校验矩阵 (最小距离d_min={min_dist})") returnP
# 全局校验矩阵P_MATRIX = make_good_P()
# 构造问题相关函数defjoin_toks(toks): return" ".join(toks)defmake_eq_expr(a, b): return["("] + a + ["=="] + b + [")"]defget_var_tok(i): return[f"S{i}"]defget_const_tok(val): return["1"]ifvalelse["0"]defbuild_eq_chain(indices): expr = get_var_tok(indices[0]) foriinindices[1:]: expr = make_eq_expr(expr, get_var_tok(i)) returnexprdefbuild_parity_question(indices, want_1=True): count =len(indices) eq_chain = build_eq_chain(indices) # 计算目标常量 target =1if(count %2==1)else0 ifnotwant_1: target =0if(count %2==1)else1 const_tok = get_const_tok(target) returnjoin_toks(make_eq_expr(eq_chain, const_tok))
# 生成所有问题defmake_questions(): questions = [] # 先加8个基础位查询 foriinrange(8): questions.append(join_toks([f"S{i}","==","1"])) # 再加9个奇偶校验查询 forrinrange(9): # 找到当前行非0的列索引 non_zero_idx = [iforiinrange(8)ifP_MATRIX[r][i]] questions.append(build_parity_question(non_zero_idx,True)) returnquestions
# 全局问题列表QUESTION_LIST = make_questions()
# ---------------- 解码答案 ----------------defdecode_ans(ans_list): # 把True/False转成1/0 ans_nums = [1ifbelse0forbinans_list] best_bits, best_dist =None,999 # 遍历所有可能的8位组合 fors_intinrange(256): s = [(s_int >> i) &1foriinrange(8)] # 计算对应的校验位 p = [sum(P_MATRIX[r][i] * s[i]foriinrange(8)) &1forrinrange(9)] current_code = s + p # 计算汉明距离 dist = calc_hamming(ans_nums, current_code) ifdist < best_dist: best_dist, best_bits = dist, s # 距离为0直接返回 ifdist ==0: break returnbest_bits, best_dist
# ---------------- 主逻辑 ----------------defrun_solver(target_ip, target_port): # 建立连接 sock = socket.create_connection((target_ip, target_port)) # 读第一行（可能是PoW） first_line = read_line(sock, timeout=3) print_log(first_line) # 解PoW并发送 if"sha256"infirst_line: pow_sol = crack_pow(first_line) send_line(sock, pow_sol) # 等待提问提示 read_until_hit(sock, ["Ask your question:"], idle_time=3) # 多轮交互 forround_numinrange(1, MAX_ROUND +1): print_log(f"n=== 第{round_num}/{MAX_ROUND}轮 ===") ans_collect = [] # 发送所有问题并收答案 forq_idx, qinenumerate(QUESTION_LIST,1): send_line(sock, q) # 等响应 resp = read_until_hit(sock, ["response","Response","Prisoner","Now reveal"], idle_time=2) ifnotresp: print_log("[!] 没收到响应，继续下一个...") continue # 提取True/False match_ans = re.search(r"(True|False)", resp, re.IGNORECASE) ifmatch_ans: ans = match_ans.group(1).lower() =="true" ans_collect.append(ans) print_log(f"[答{q_idx:
02d}]{ans} ({resp})") else: print_log(f"[?] 没找到答案:{resp}") # 等揭示提示 read_until_hit(sock, ["Now reveal"], idle_time=2) # 解码并发送结果 final_bits, dist = decode_ans(ans_collect) print_log(f"[解码] 最佳距离={dist}比特={''.join(map(str, final_bits))}") send_line(sock," ".join(map(str, final_bits))) # 等下一轮提示或结果 next_resp = read_until_hit(sock, ["Ask your question","defeat","laughs"], idle_time=3) if"laughs"innext_resp: print_log("[!] 囚犯笑了 - 失败了") sock.close() return if"defeat"innext_resp: print_log("[+] 囚犯被打败了!") break # 输出最终结果 print_log("n=== 最终输出 ===") read_until_hit(sock, [], idle_time=3) sock.close()if__name__ =="__main__": # 优先从命令行取IP和端口 target_ip, target_port = IP, PORT iflen(sys.argv) >=2: target_ip = sys.argv[1] iflen(sys.argv) >=3: target_port =int(sys.argv[2]) run_solver(target_ip, target_port)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-"""decode_mmx.py使用 encode.dat 与 encode.dat.key 执行解码，恢复原始明文。算法逆向来源：butterfly 二进制 main(sub_4018D0)- 每 8 字节为一块，记 key8 为密钥的前 8 字节；- 编码过程： 1) x = block XOR key8 2) y = swap_bytes_in_16bit_words(x) # 每个 16-bit 内部字节互换 3) z = rol64(y, 1) # 64 位整体左旋 1 bit 4) out = z + key8 # 逐字节相加（模 256）- 解码过程（逆操作）： 1) z = out - key8 # 逐字节相减（模 256） 2) y = ror64(z, 1) # 64 位整体右旋 1 bit 3) x = swap_bytes_in_16bit_words(y) # 再次互换回去 4) block = x XOR key8用法： python decode_mmx.py encode.dat encode.dat.key [output]默认输出文件名为：decoded.out"""importsysfromtypingimportTupledefswap_bytes_in_16bit_words(b:
bytes) ->bytes: iflen(b) !=8: raiseValueError("块长度必须为 8 字节") out =bytearray(8) # 以 16-bit 为单位交换字节： [0]<->[1], [2]<->[3], [4]<->[5], [6]<->[7] foriinrange(0,8,2): out[i] = b[i+1] out[i+1] = b[i] returnbytes(out)defrol64(b:
bytes, r:
int) ->bytes: # 64 位整体旋转，按小端/大端均等价于按位旋转 val =int.from_bytes(b,'little') r &=63 val = ((val << r) | (val >> (64- r))) & ((1<<64) -1) returnval.to_bytes(8,'little')defror64(b:
bytes, r:
int) ->bytes: val =int.from_bytes(b,'little') r &=63 val = ((val >> r) | (val << (64- r))) & ((1<<64) -1) returnval.to_bytes(8,'little')defdecode_block(block:
bytes, key8:
bytes) ->bytes: iflen(block) !=8orlen(key8) !=8: raiseValueError("块与密钥必须为 8 字节") # 逆序： out -> z -> y -> x -> block # step 1: z = out - key8 (mod 256) z =bytes(((block[i] - key8[i]) &0xFF)foriinrange(8)) # step 2: y = ror64(z, 1) y = ror64(z,1) # step 3: x = swap_bytes_in_16bit_words(y) x = swap_bytes_in_16bit_words(y) # step 4: block = x XOR key8 returnbytes((x[i] ^ key8[i])foriinrange(8))defdecode_file(enc_path:
str, key_path:
str) ->bytes: withopen(enc_path,'rb')asf: enc = f.read() withopen(key_path,'rb')asf: key = f.read() iflen(key) <8: raiseValueError("密钥文件长度不足 8 字节：%s"% key_path) key8 = key[:8] out =bytearray() i =0 whilei +8<=len(enc): out += decode_block(enc[i:i+8], key8) i +=8 ifi <len(enc): out += enc[i:] returnbytes(out)defmain(): iflen(sys.argv) <3: print("用法: python decode_mmx.py encode.dat encode.dat.key [output]") sys.exit(1) enc_path = sys.argv[1] key_path = sys.argv[2] out_path = sys.argv[3]iflen(sys.argv) >=4else'decoded.out' try: data = decode_file(enc_path, key_path) exceptExceptionase: print("解码失败:", e) sys.exit(2) withopen(out_path,'wb')asf: f.write(data) print("解码完成: %s (大小: %d 字节)"% (out_path,len(data)))if__name__ =='__main__': main()

破解 PoW：暴力连接后破解 SHA256 哈希验证，通过暴力遍历 4 位字符组合，找到符合哈希条件的前缀，完成验证。构造问题与交互：每轮发送 17 个问题（8 个基础查询如 “S0 == 1”+9 个校验查询），收集含 2 个错误的回答，转为 1/0 序列。解码真实秘密：遍历 256 种 8 位秘密组合，计算各组合对应的 17 位码字，找到与回答序列汉明距离最小的组合，即为真实秘密。完成多轮挑战：每轮提交解码结果，共进行 25 轮。全部正确后获取 flag

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-"""The_Interrogation_Room solver — 稳定交互版（精简命名版）"""importsys, socket, re, time, hashlib, random, selectfromitertoolsimportproduct
# 基本配置IP ="39.106.45.153"PORT =24586MAX_ROUND =25
# PoW字符集CHAR_SET ="abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"# ---------------- 基础IO操作 ----------------defread_line(sock, timeout=None): iftimeout: ready, _, _ = select.select([sock], [], [], timeout) ifnotready: return"" data =b"" whileTrue: char = sock.recv(1) ifnotchar: break data += char ifchar ==b"n": break returndata.decode(errors="ignore").rstrip("rn")ifdataelse""defsend_line(sock, content): sock.sendall((content +"n").encode())defprint_log(msg): print(msg, flush=True)defread_until_hit(sock, keywords, idle_time=1.5, print_msg=True): sock.setblocking(0) buf, last_recv =b"", time.monotonic() whileTrue: ready, _, _ = select.select([sock], [], [],0.1) ifready: chunk = sock.recv(4096) ifnotchunk: break buf += chunk whileb"n"inbuf: line, buf = buf.split(b"n",1) line = line.decode(errors="ignore").rstrip("rn") ifprint_msg: print_log(line) ifany(keyinlineforkeyinkeywords): sock.setblocking(1) returnline last_recv = time.monotonic() eliftime.monotonic() - last_recv > idle_time: break sock.setblocking(1) return""# ---------------- 解PoW ----------------defcrack_pow(line, report_step=200000): match= re.search(r"sha256(XXXX+([A-Za-z0-9]+))s*==s*([0-9a-f]{64})", line) ifnotmatch: raiseValueError("没找到PoW相关内容") suffix, target_hash =match.group(1),match.group(2) total =len(CHAR_SET) **4 tried, start_time =0, time.monotonic() # 遍历所有4位组合 fora, b, c, dinproduct(CHAR_SET, repeat=4): xxxx = a + b + c + d current_hash = hashlib.sha256((xxxx + suffix).encode()).hexdigest() tried +=1 ifcurrent_hash == target_hash: print_log(f"[PoW] 解出来了: XXXX={xxxx}(耗时{time.monotonic() - start_time:.2f}s)") returnxxxx # 定期输出进度 iftried % report_step ==0: cost_time = time.monotonic() - start_time speed = tried /max(cost_time,1e-9) print_log(f"[PoW] 已试={tried:,}速度={speed /1e5:.2f}e5次/秒") raiseRuntimeError("PoW没解出来")
# ---------------- 生成编码相关 ----------------defcalc_hamming(a, b): returnsum(x ^ yforx, yinzip(a, b))
# 生成合格的校验矩阵Pdefmake_good_P(): rnd = random.Random() whileTrue: # 生成9行8列的01矩阵 P = [[rnd.randint(0,1)for_inrange(8)]for_inrange(9)] # 排除全0行 ifany(sum(row) ==0forrowinP): continue # 计算所有码字的最小汉明距离 code_words = [] fors_intinrange(256): s = [(s_int >> i) &1foriinrange(8)] p = [sum(P[r][i] * s[i]foriinrange(8)) &1forrinrange(9)] code_words.append(s + p) min_dist =9 foriinrange(256): forjinrange(i +1,256): dist = calc_hamming(code_words[i], code_words[j]) ifdist < min_dist: min_dist = dist ifmin_dist <5: break ifmin_dist <5: break ifmin_dist >=5: print_log(f"[CODE] 生成校验矩阵 (最小距离d_min={min_dist})") returnP
# 全局校验矩阵P_MATRIX = make_good_P()
# 构造问题相关函数defjoin_toks(toks): return" ".join(toks)defmake_eq_expr(a, b): return["("] + a + ["=="] + b + [")"]defget_var_tok(i): return[f"S{i}"]defget_const_tok(val): return["1"]ifvalelse["0"]defbuild_eq_chain(indices): expr = get_var_tok(indices[0]) foriinindices[1:]: expr = make_eq_expr(expr, get_var_tok(i)) returnexprdefbuild_parity_question(indices, want_1=True): count =len(indices) eq_chain = build_eq_chain(indices) # 计算目标常量 target =1if(count %2==1)else0 ifnotwant_1: target =0if(count %2==1)else1 const_tok = get_const_tok(target) returnjoin_toks(make_eq_expr(eq_chain, const_tok))
# 生成所有问题defmake_questions(): questions = [] # 先加8个基础位查询 foriinrange(8): questions.append(join_toks([f"S{i}","==","1"])) # 再加9个奇偶校验查询 forrinrange(9): # 找到当前行非0的列索引 non_zero_idx = [iforiinrange(8)ifP_MATRIX[r][i]] questions.append(build_parity_question(non_zero_idx,True)) returnquestions
# 全局问题列表QUESTION_LIST = make_questions()
# ---------------- 解码答案 ----------------defdecode_ans(ans_list): # 把True/False转成1/0 ans_nums = [1ifbelse0forbinans_list] best_bits, best_dist =None,999 # 遍历所有可能的8位组合 fors_intinrange(256): s = [(s_int >> i) &1foriinrange(8)] # 计算对应的校验位 p = [sum(P_MATRIX[r][i] * s[i]foriinrange(8)) &1forrinrange(9)] current_code = s + p # 计算汉明距离 dist = calc_hamming(ans_nums, current_code) ifdist < best_dist: best_dist, best_bits = dist, s # 距离为0直接返回 ifdist ==0: break returnbest_bits, best_dist
# ---------------- 主逻辑 ----------------defrun_solver(target_ip, target_port): # 建立连接 sock = socket.create_connection((target_ip, target_port)) # 读第一行（可能是PoW） first_line = read_line(sock, timeout=3) print_log(first_line) # 解PoW并发送 if"sha256"infirst_line: pow_sol = crack_pow(first_line) send_line(sock, pow_sol) # 等待提问提示 read_until_hit(sock, ["Ask your question:"], idle_time=3) # 多轮交互 forround_numinrange(1, MAX_ROUND +1): print_log(f"n=== 第{round_num}/{MAX_ROUND}轮 ===") ans_collect = [] # 发送所有问题并收答案 forq_idx, qinenumerate(QUESTION_LIST,1): send_line(sock, q) # 等响应 resp = read_until_hit(sock, ["response","Response","Prisoner","Now reveal"], idle_time=2) ifnotresp: print_log("[!] 没收到响应，继续下一个...") continue # 提取True/False match_ans = re.search(r"(True|False)", resp, re.IGNORECASE) ifmatch_ans: ans = match_ans.group(1).lower() =="true" ans_collect.append(ans) print_log(f"[答{q_idx:
02d}]{ans} ({resp})") else: print_log(f"[?] 没找到答案:{resp}") # 等揭示提示 read_until_hit(sock, ["Now reveal"], idle_time=2) # 解码并发送结果 final_bits, dist = decode_ans(ans_collect) print_log(f"[解码] 最佳距离={dist}比特={''.join(map(str, final_bits))}") send_line(sock," ".join(map(str, final_bits))) # 等下一轮提示或结果 next_resp = read_until_hit(sock, ["Ask your question","defeat","laughs"], idle_time=3) if"laughs"innext_resp: print_log("[!] 囚犯笑了 - 失败了") sock.close() return if"defeat"innext_resp: print_log("[+] 囚犯被打败了!") break # 输出最终结果 print_log("n=== 最终输出 ===") read_until_hit(sock, [], idle_time=3) sock.close()if__name__ =="__main__": # 优先从命令行取IP和端口 target_ip, target_port = IP, PORT iflen(sys.argv) >=2: target_ip = sys.argv[1] iflen(sys.argv) >=3: target_port =int(sys.argv[2]) run_solver(target_ip, target_port)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-"""decode_mmx.py使用 encode.dat 与 encode.dat.key 执行解码，恢复原始明文。算法逆向来源：butterfly 二进制 main(sub_4018D0)- 每 8 字节为一块，记 key8 为密钥的前 8 字节；- 编码过程： 1) x = block XOR key8 2) y = swap_bytes_in_16bit_words(x) # 每个 16-bit 内部字节互换 3) z = rol64(y, 1) # 64 位整体左旋 1 bit 4) out = z + key8 # 逐字节相加（模 256）- 解码过程（逆操作）： 1) z = out - key8 # 逐字节相减（模 256） 2) y = ror64(z, 1) # 64 位整体右旋 1 bit 3) x = swap_bytes_in_16bit_words(y) # 再次互换回去 4) block = x XOR key8用法： python decode_mmx.py encode.dat encode.dat.key [output]默认输出文件名为：decoded.out"""importsysfromtypingimportTupledefswap_bytes_in_16bit_words(b:
bytes) ->bytes: iflen(b) !=8: raiseValueError("块长度必须为 8 字节") out =bytearray(8) # 以 16-bit 为单位交换字节： [0]<->[1], [2]<->[3], [4]<->[5], [6]<->[7] foriinrange(0,8,2): out[i] = b[i+1] out[i+1] = b[i] returnbytes(out)defrol64(b:
bytes, r:
int) ->bytes: # 64 位整体旋转，按小端/大端均等价于按位旋转 val =int.from_bytes(b,'little') r &=63 val = ((val << r) | (val >> (64- r))) & ((1<<64) -1) returnval.to_bytes(8,'little')defror64(b:
bytes, r:
int) ->bytes: val =int.from_bytes(b,'little') r &=63 val = ((val >> r) | (val << (64- r))) & ((1<<64) -1) returnval.to_bytes(8,'little')defdecode_block(block:
bytes, key8:
bytes) ->bytes: iflen(block) !=8orlen(key8) !=8: raiseValueError("块与密钥必须为 8 字节") # 逆序： out -> z -> y -> x -> block # step 1: z = out - key8 (mod 256) z =bytes(((block[i] - key8[i]) &0xFF)foriinrange(8)) # step 2: y = ror64(z, 1) y = ror64(z,1) # step 3: x = swap_bytes_in_16bit_words(y) x = swap_bytes_in_16bit_words(y) # step 4: block = x XOR key8 returnbytes((x[i] ^ key8[i])foriinrange(8))defdecode_file(enc_path:
str, key_path:
str) ->bytes: withopen(enc_path,'rb')asf: enc = f.read() withopen(key_path,'rb')asf: key = f.read() iflen(key) <8: raiseValueError("密钥文件长度不足 8 字节：%s"% key_path) key8 = key[:8] out =bytearray() i =0 whilei +8<=len(enc): out += decode_block(enc[i:i+8], key8) i +=8 ifi <len(enc): out += enc[i:] returnbytes(out)defmain(): iflen(sys.argv) <3: print("用法: python decode_mmx.py encode.dat encode.dat.key [output]") sys.exit(1) enc_path = sys.argv[1] key_path = sys.argv[2] out_path = sys.argv[3]iflen(sys.argv) >=4else'decoded.out' try: data = decode_file(enc_path, key_path) exceptExceptionase: print("解码失败:", e) sys.exit(2) withopen(out_path,'wb')asf: f.write(data) print("解码完成: %s (大小: %d 字节)"% (out_path,len(data)))if__name__ =='__main__': main()
